The failure is a static-check false positive: the word "input" in the comments trips the forbidden-construct filter. The topology is a standard StrongARM with reset devices and output inverters. Below I remove the word, tidy the comments, and make the energy estimate more conservative.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (10.0, 6.0, 16.0),       # diff pair gm/Id intent at evaluation start
    "I_in":    (200e-6, 50e-6, 800e-6), # per-side pair current at evaluation start
    "Wt_ratio":(1.0, 0.5, 3.0),         # tail width relative to 2*W_pair
    "Wln":     (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),         # latch nfet width [um]
    "Wlp":     (2.0, 0.6, 8.0),         # latch pfet width [um]
    "Wrst":    (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),        # reset pfet width [um]
    "Winv":    (1.0, 0.42, 6.0),        # output inverter nfet width [um] (pfet = 2x)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    dv = spec.get("dv", 0.002)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    vdd = 1.8
    L = 0.15
    # Differential pair sized at L=0.15 from gm/Id intent
    m_pr = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], L, p["I_in"], vds=0.3)
    W_pr = max(0.42, m_pr.W)
    W_t = max(0.42, p["Wt_ratio"] * 2 * W_pr)
    Wln, Wlp, Wr, Wi = p["Wln"], p["Wlp"], p["Wrst"], p["Winv"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn clk outp outn vdd vss")
    # Tail switch
    n.M("MT", "t", "clk", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W_t, L)
    # Differential pair
    n.M("M1", "dp", "vinp", "t", "vss", "nfet", W_pr, L)
    n.M("M2", "dn", "vinn", "t", "vss", "nfet", W_pr, L)
    # Cross-coupled latch (lp sits above the vinp side, falls first when vinp>vinn)
    n.M("M3", "lp", "ln", "dp", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M4", "ln", "lp", "dn", "vss", "nfet", Wln, L)
    n.M("M5", "lp", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    n.M("M6", "ln", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wlp, L)
    # Reset switches (clk low) on all internal nodes
    n.M("MR1", "lp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR2", "ln", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR3", "dp", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    n.M("MR4", "dn", "clk", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wr, L)
    # Output inverters: outp = NOT(lp) -> high when vinp>vinn
    n.M("MI1", "outp", "lp", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI2", "outp", "lp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)
    n.M("MI3", "outn", "ln", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wi, L)
    n.M("MI4", "outn", "ln", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2 * Wi, L)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    cw = 1.0e-15   # ~F per um of width, gate + junction (L=0.15)
    c_latch = cw * (Wln + Wlp) * 2 + cw * Wr + cw * 3 * Wi   # per latch node
    c_d = cw * (W_pr * 0.6 + Wln * 0.6 + Wr)                  # per integration node
    gm_n = lut.op("n", Wln, L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    gm_p = lut.op("p", Wlp, L, 0.9, 0.9)["gm"]
    gm_lat = gm_n + gm_p
    tau = c_latch / max(gm_lat, 1e-6)
    i_pr0 = lut.op("n", W_pr, L, 0.9, 0.5)["Id"]
    t_int = c_d * 1.0 / max(i_pr0, 1e-6)                      # dp/dn discharge ~ Vth
    av = max(1.0, m_pr.gm * t_int / max(c_d, 1e-18))
    t_reg = tau * math.log(max(2.0, vdd / 2 / (av * dv)))
    t_inv = 0.69 * (cl + 2e-15) * 2.5e3 / max(Wi, 0.42)
    delay = t_int + t_reg + t_inv
    # every internal node is pulled low and reset once per cycle; one output swings
    c_sw = 2 * c_d + 2 * c_latch + cw * W_t + 2 * cw * W_pr + (cl + 3e-15 * Wi)
    energy = c_sw * vdd ** 2
    return n, {"correct": 1, "delay": delay, "energy": energy}
```
